name: Lovers & Assassins: Taming the Shadows
source:
It's your final task as an apprentice assassin. Your real life begins on the other side of this mission. Will you complete the graduation kill – or die trying?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
這是你作為刺客學徒的最後一個任務。跨過這道坎，你真正的人生才會開始。你能殺死目標、順利出師，還是會死在這次行動中？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
